sentences.en: The Renaissance festival had stores selling swords, clothing and jewelry.
sentences.zh: 文艺复兴节上有卖剑、服装和珠宝的商店。

sentences.en: The fairy at the Renaissance festival was just an actor.
sentences.zh: 文艺复兴节上的仙女只是一个演员。

sentences.en: The Renaissance was a cultural movement that started in Italy.
sentences.zh: 文艺复兴时期是一个从意大利开始的文化运动。

senses.zh: (Renaissance) 文艺复兴，文艺复兴风格
